title: WorkerCapabilities
description: What a worker build can run, sent with every claim (REPORT 6.1.7). Node hands a worker only runs whose requirements this meets, so an older worker never receives a run it would misread. Code constants of the build, never configuration.

supportedSchemaVersions.description: RunSpec schemaVersions this worker's models read.

foldVersion.description: The highest fold version this worker folds (its FOLD_VERSION); it also writes at it.

features.description: Run shapes beyond the spec and fold versions that this worker's models accept, by name (e.g. chat, caller, steering). Open vocabulary: a reader ignores names it does not know, so a feature ships to workers before Node requires it.
